svg.text: Dashed wires carry high-frequency GPS telemetry (steps 1-2) and control-plane policies;
solid wires trace synchronous ride matching, ETA ranking, and Raft trip commits (3-6).
Separating volatile GPS updates from durable trip storage prevents high-frequency writes from saturating consensus logs.
